title: Use AVX512 Galois field affine transformation for bit shuffling
key_contribution: Demonstrated that VGF2P8AFFINEQB can implement arbitrary byte-level bit shuffling including 64x64 bit matrix transposition, opening the door to using GFNI for non-cryptographic byte transformations.

title: Multiplying 64x64 bit-matrices with GF2P8AFFINEQB
key_contribution: Showed efficient 64x64 bit matrix multiplication using VGF2P8AFFINEQB for block-matrix decomposition over GF(2), relevant to expressing Base64 lookup as matrix multiplication.

title: Screaming Fast Galois Field Arithmetic Using Intel SIMD Instructions
venue: FAST (USENIX Conference on File and Storage Technologies)
key_contribution: Pioneered using PSHUFB for GF(2^8) multiplication via table splitting, establishing the precedent for using SIMD shuffle instructions for algebraic operations.

title: GF2P8AFFINEINVQB — Galois Field Affine Transformation Inverse (Intel ISA Reference)
venue: Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual
key_contribution: Official specification of GFNI instructions including VGF2P8AFFINEQB, documenting the 8x8 bit-matrix multiply + XOR semantics.
